opening.argument: The presentation pairs a headline claiming 251 ETH/BNB earnings with a specific flash-loan arbitrage bot and a destination for using it. Viewers are directed to open that bot, select an opportunity and loan amount, then deposit and confirm a fee through MetaMask or Trust Wallet. The spoken instructions make the payment step explicit: “Deposit flashloan fee into the contract. Confirm the fee from your wallet and head back to execute flashloan arbitrage.” The displayed panel adds an estimated profit, a Deposit BNB button, and an execution control, while the description says the bot will execute trades and split the profit between users and developers. Although presented as a tutorial, the material connects its earning claim to a linked web app and wallet-confirmed payment.
